articles.title: Storm Rachel Weakens but Keeps Soaking the Southwest
articles.summary: Rachel brought flooding to Southern California and record rain to Las Vegas, and forecasters say a strong El Niño could bring more storms this winter.

articles.title: Trump Announces 'Energy Ceasefire' Between Russia and Ukraine
articles.summary: President Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to stop attacking energy sites, but he gave no details, and Ukraine reported more attacks afterward.

articles.title: New Limits on Chinese Drones Leave Police Facing Higher Costs
articles.summary: The U.S. government is limiting Chinese-made drones, but many police departments rely on them for rescues and say American ones cost much more.
